name: Shindrell's Note
summary: In Astranaar, Shindrell Swiftfire writes a missive about corruption near the town and along Ashenvale's coast. She sends the intelligence report east through the forest to Kayneth Stillwind.

sections.title: A Missive Across the Woods
sections.body: Sentinels and druids coordinate to watch Ashenvale's borders as unrest spreads through the forest. In Astranaar, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire writes of troubling disturbances along the western coast and among the central canopies. She addresses her report to Kayneth Stillwind, a druid at the shrine of Forest Song in the Nightsong Woods to the east. Couriers carry Shindrell's firsthand observations to aid Kayneth's investigation of corruption creeping through the sacred groves.

faq.answer: Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire's field report describes disturbances and suspected corruption near Astranaar and along the Ashenvale coastline.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive the note?
aliases: who do I give this to
faq.answer: The note is addressed to Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf druid at Forest Song in the Nightsong Woods in eastern Ashenvale.

aliases: what corruption is shindrell talking about
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind requested reports of unusual occurrences in the western forests because he feared corruption was taking root there. Shindrell gathered her sightings to help him judge the threat.
Shindrell Swiftfire is a night elf sentinel stationed at Astranaar, a settlement in central Ashenvale.

angles.text: The missive shows Sentinels defending Ashenvale's settlements working with Cenarion druids who study the forest's sickness.
Shindrell's observations help Kayneth Stillwind and his fellow druids uncover the roots of the unnatural blight troubling Ashenvale.
